text:
maya: Heads up — finalizing run-of-show + speaker cue cards for Tue webinar 'Dedicated Inference: Ops & Handoffs'. Need confirmation on demo ordering, who's doing what, and fallback plan. @alex @priya @noah

alex: I can handle the product demo (30m). Will need a signed staging token and short checklist for demo prep. What's the order? slides -> demo -> live q?

priya: Slides -> demo -> Q/A works. I'll do host intro + 5m slides. alex does demo, noah handles infra > handoff. Can we keep demo to 12m? don't want to overrun.

noah: I'll cover infra, rollout options, and failover. For failover: plan to switch traffic to hosted endpoint `redwood-hosted/v1` if staging flakiness. Will have a toggle in the console during the run.

sara: I'll own speaker cue cards and timekeeper. Sending draft in 30m. We should call out the fallback command and which model to pick.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. Can you add the exact CLI toggle snippet to the cue cards so alex has it? e.g., `rwctl route switch --target hosted --model rwd-small-v1`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run of demo environment at 2026-04-01T16:00Z — health checks OK

alex: Demo checklist: staging token, dataset (short prompt set), recording on, console visible. Ping me when staging is reachable.

maya: Run-of-show draft (keep it tight):
```
00:00 - 00:05 | Host intro (Priya)
00:05 - 00:12 | Product + econ narrative (Maya)
00:12 - 00:24 | Live demo (Alex)
00:24 - 00:34 | Infra & ops: rollouts + fallbacks (Noah)
00:34 - 00:45 | Q/A + audience polls (All)
``` 
Thoughts?

priya: Looks good. Suggest trimming demo to 10m and give 6m to infra so we can show fallback live.

maya: OK trimming demo to 10m. Updated:
```
00:12 - 00:22 | Live demo (Alex)
00:22 - 00:34 | Infra & ops (Noah)
```

noah: I'll prep a short script for the fallback: show an intentional throttle, then run `rwctl route switch --target hosted --model rwd-small-v1` and verify response < 300ms. Also will have a backup slide with canned logs.

sara: Cue cards note: when alex hits demo, cue 'show token panel' and 'switch to console view' — I'll do visual cue + 10s countdown before switching slides.

maya: Anyone want to run the chair for audience q? I can take first 10m, then Priya closes.

alex: I'm good to hand mic to Priya after infra. Also can share a short explainer GIF if demo fails.

maya: Great. Final asks before I lock the doc: - Alex: confirm staging token and demo dataset - Noah: prepare fallback script + backup slide - Sara: draft cue cards + timekeeper sheet - Priya: 1-paragraph host intro
I'll lock doc EOD PST.

noah: All set from infra side. I'll drop the fallback script in the shared drive by EOD.

sara: Cue cards incoming in 25.

alex: Token and dataset in the drive. Verified demo recorded locally. :fire:

maya: :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll post the final run-of-show in #marketing once locked.
